title: Apple (AAPL) is Gillespie Robinson & Grimm Inc.’s 2nd Largest Position

organizations.name: 2nd largest position    gillespie robinson & grimm inc.

text:
Gillespie Robinson & Grimm Inc. boosted its holdings in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.3% during the fourth quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 199,659 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 555 shares during the period. Apple comprises about 4.3% of Gillespie Robinson & Grimm Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 2nd biggest holding. Gillespie Robinson & Grimm Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $33,788,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. 
A number of other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also modified their holdings of AAPL. Blue Sky Asset Management LLC acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the second quarter valued at approximately $108,000. FNY Managed Accounts LLC increased its stake in shares of Apple by 852.4% in the second quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after purchasing an additional 716 shares during the period. Private Vista LLC acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the second quarter valued at approximately $122,000. Crow Point Partners LLC increased its stake in shares of Apple by 100.0% in the third quarter. Crow Point Partners LLC now owns 1,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $153,000 after purchasing an additional 500 shares during the period. Finally, Oak Point Wealth Management acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the fourth quarter valued at approximately $163,000. 61.33% of the stock is currently owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. Several brokerages have commented on AAPL. Nomura restated a “neutral” rating and issued a $175.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Monday. Rosenblatt Securities restated a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, March 16th. Barclays dropped their price target on shares of Apple from $170.00 to $168.00 and set an “equal weight” rating on the stock in a research note on Friday, March 16th. Royal Bank of Canada restated a “buy” rating and issued a $205.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, March 9th. Finally, Vetr lowered shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $183.68 price target on the stock. in a research note on Tuesday, March 6th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $201.53. Apple stock opened at $171.27 on Thursday. The firm has a market cap of $889,170.13, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.60, a PEG ratio of 1.32 and a beta of 1.19. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. Apple has a twelve month low of $138.62 and a twelve month high of $183.50. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the firm earned $3.36 EPS. sell-side analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
In other news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders.

The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
